decisions.direction: Apple-style minimal, full-bleed. Fluid gutters (px-site), no max-width container; hero name fitted to the screen width with container query units.

type.accent: Instrument Serif italic — one word at most

components.@ibelick/morphing-dialog: src/components/motion-primitives/morphing-dialog.tsx — certificate viewer (backdrop changed to solid ink, no blur)
components.@ibelick/text-effect: src/components/motion-primitives/text-effect.tsx — hero name letter reveal on load

decisions.motion: Load-time, interaction and scroll-linked horizontal movement only. No scroll-triggered fade/reveal. Project previews are looping muted MP4 screen recordings in public/work/.
decisions.work_gallery: Sticky horizontal scroll gallery: vertical scroll drives the project track right→left (Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform/useSpring, SCROLL_RATIO 0.7). Reduced motion falls back to a swipeable snap row.
